requirements.description: User prefers the commercial unit to be near parks. Proximity expressed as preference, so the threshold is set at the 75th percentile of the green distribution (74.26), rounded to 74.

The user explicitly requires at least 115 sqm of gross floor area. The 15-person capacity is not converted into a surface filter because no verified gross-area threshold was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent.
User prefers energy class D or better, so all classes from A1 to D are accepted.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: commercial property type, surface_area >= 115, energy_class from A1 to D (the energy_class IN list), green >= 74, and a 3.0 km haversine radius around 45.0677551, 7.6824892. Ordered by distance to that point. The gross floor area, 15-person capacity, and Turin place name were not among the extracted requirements, so they are not used as predicates.
